## Motivation

`test_mixed_logprob_batch_frame` has failed `base-a-test-cpu` on main since #47106 merged ([report](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47106#issuecomment-6534080230), e.g. [this job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41126892409/job/124315366100)):

```
File "python/sglang/srt/rust_server/server.py", line 580, in push_generation
    offsets = payload.output_ids_offsets
AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'output_ids_offsets'
```

#47415 made `RustServer.push_generation` read each step's output ids as `output_ids_flat` plus `output_ids_offsets`. #47106 added this test on an older base, with the per-row `output_ids` list. Each PR passed CI on its own base; the conflict only shows on main.

## Modifications

Build the test's payload with `output_ids_flat` / `output_ids_offsets` for the same rows (`[7, 8]`, `[9]`, `[5]`, `[]`), in the literal form #47415 used for the other payloads in this file. The test's assertions are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, test-only change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A, test-only change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort 7.0.0, ruff 0.15.1 check + format, codespell 2.4.1 at the pinned versions)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `test_rust_server_extension.py`: 9 passed locally; on main's version of the file, `test_mixed_logprob_batch_frame` fails with the `AttributeError` above.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
